C1251.title: Five Staten Island Residents Charged in a Million-Dollar Apple Gift Card Fraud Scheme
C1251.summary: In October 2021, the Richmond County District Attorney's Office announced the arrest and arraignment of five Staten Island residents. Prosecutors alleged that they used information stolen from American Express account holders to obtain Apple gift cards and buy Apple products for resale. Searches recovered more than $787,000 in unused gift cards, $118,000 in cash, and multiple Apple products.
